mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, facility_id, status, request_reason, access_start_at, access_end_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM access_requests WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id, facility_id, status, request_reason, access_start_at, access_end_at, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, reject_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM access_requests WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO access_requests ( user_id, status, facility_id, request_reason, access_start_at, access_end_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{status}, #{facilityId}, #{requestReason}, #{accessStartAt}, #{accessEndAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE access_requests SET status = #{newStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = #{currentStatus}
